title: 第17章 狂野锻造术第18章 锻造就是艺术
content_zh:
;;
敖鹏研究了一会儿自己的神通种子，暂时只得到了双倍返还这个效果。
不过这也已经很逆天了。
纯纯的肉坦神技，也就是只要敖鹏肉得住，无论多强大的敌人，都要吃上一次自己的双倍攻击。
足以完成很多逆天的操作，不愧其‘神通’之名。
退出了游戏，敖鹏看了看时间，刚好晚上十点过，于是他登上了旧土游戏论坛。
他之前和弟弟敖武沟通过，知道了敖武的论坛名称。
夜晚，正在写作业的敖武手机响了，他打开手机，看到旧土游戏的私聊框有一条信息。
【‘好命人’请求加好友。】
好命人就是敖鹏的游戏昵称，敖武点‘是’。
然后两兄弟对了暗号，确定不是别人。
“哥，我过新手村了，按照你给的攻略，我这两天没怎么玩游戏，都是在挂机存香火。”
敖鹏对弟弟过第一关游戏并不意外，这也是他联系敖武的原因。
真正接触过‘货郎’财源广进真君之后，他更加深刻意识到这次系统的新手福利有多大。
比起锻炼敖武，还是将看得见的好处拿到手再说。
“对了，你命格是多少？”
“5两9钱，哥，你命格多少？”
敖鹏点开命格对照表。
5两9钱命，细推此格妙且清，必定才高礼仪通，甲第之中应有分，扬鞭走马显威荣。
这确实挺符合敖武的情况。

他打个马虎说道，“都是一个妈生的，我和你差不多，只是比你低一点点。”
说完，敖鹏给敖武转了5000香火，一门珠心算。
只不过他牢记攻略里面大佬教的。
香火不只是钱，也是因果，就算亲兄弟也需要明算账。
不然他单独给敖武好处，看似为弟弟敖武好，但不知道哪天敖武就得把命还给他。
所以敖鹏借助系统，给了敖武一个任务。
【‘好命人’向你下达了一个任务，任务奖励：5000香火，技能珠心算，你是否接受？】
敖武果断点了接受。
【你接受了‘好命人’的任务，好命人请求你修补八种他得到的残破的武器。】
随后敖鹏将自己从财源广进真君那里抽到的残破武器一股脑丢给了敖武，反正修补武器又不是百分之百修补好，只要敖武有这个诚心修补的过程，那么无论结果好坏，因果都两消。
“哥，你从哪里搞到这些好东西的？”
虽然是残破武器，但敖武玩了几天这游戏，连个基础锻造材料都没跑出来。
“抽的。”
敖鹏没有多说，然后提醒道，“货郎来了记得先刷福袋，五百五百的刷，刷到有感觉了，一股脑都扔福袋里，绝对赚！我这边忙其他事情，先下了。”
敖鹏退出了私聊，敖武本来想要重新静下心来写作业。
但是5000香火的巨款在手，再加上他做了一两个小跑腿任务和之前积累的香火，已经有5500香火。
content_en:

Ao Peng studied his magical seeds for a while, and for the time being he only got the double return effect.
But this is already outrageous.
A pure tanking skill, that is, as long as Ao Peng can hold on, no matter how powerful the enemy is, he will receive his double attack.
It is enough to complete many heaven-defying operations, and it is worthy of its name of 'supernatural power'.
After exiting the game, Ao Peng looked at the time. It was just after ten o'clock in the evening, so he logged on to the Old Earth Game Forum.
He had communicated with his younger brother Ao Wu before and knew the name of Ao Wu's forum.
At night, Ao Wu's cell phone rang while he was doing homework. He turned it on and saw a message in the private chat box of the old game.
[‘Good Luck Man’ requests to be added as a friend. 】
Good Luck Man is Ao Peng’s nickname in the game, Ao Wu clicks ‘Yes’.
Then the two brothers checked the code and made sure it was someone else.
"Brother, I've been through Novice Village. According to the guide you gave me, I haven't played much games in the past two days. I've been hanging up to save incense."
Ao Peng was not surprised that his younger brother passed the first level of the game, which is why he contacted Ao Wu.
After actually coming into contact with the 'merchant' Caiyuan Guangjin Zhenjun, he became more deeply aware of how great the newbie benefits of this system are.
Rather than training Ao Wu, it’s better to get the visible benefits.
"By the way, what is your destiny?"
"Five taels and nine cents, brother, what's your fortune?"
Ao Peng clicked on the horoscope comparison table.
5 liang and 9 coins are destined. If you look closely at this pattern, it is wonderful and clear. You must have high etiquette and good manners. You should be in the first place and show your majesty with a whip and a horse.
This is indeed consistent with Ao Wu's situation.
He said casually, "We are all born to the same mother. I am almost the same as you, just a little lower than you."
After saying that, Ao Peng transferred 5,000 incense to Ao Wu and a piece of abacus.
It's just that he kept in mind what the boss taught in the guide.
Incense is not only money, but also cause and effect. Even brothers need to settle accounts.
Otherwise, he would give Ao Wu benefits alone, which seemed to be good for his younger brother Ao Wu, but he didn't know that one day Ao Wu would have to give his life back to him.
So Ao Peng used the system to give Ao Wu a task.
[The ‘Good Luck Man’ has assigned you a task. The task reward is: 5,000 incense and the skill Abacus Mental Arithmetic. Do you accept it? 】
Ao Wu decisively clicked accept.
[You accepted the mission of the ‘Good Luck Man’. The Good Luck Man asked you to repair the eight broken weapons he obtained. 】
Then Ao Peng threw all the broken weapons that he had drawn from Zhenjun Caiyuan Guangjin to Ao Wu. Repairing the weapons was not 100% repairable anyway. As long as Ao Wu had this sincere repair process, no matter whether the result was good or bad, the cause and effect would be eliminated.
"Brother, where did you get these good things?"
Although it was a broken weapon, Ao Wu had played this game for several days and didn't even get any basic forging materials.
"Smoke."
Ao Peng didn't say much, and then reminded, "When the salesman comes, remember to swipe the lucky bag first. Swipe for five hundred and five hundred until you feel it. Throw it all into the lucky bag. You will definitely make a profit! I'm busy with other things here, so I'll leave first."
Ao Peng withdrew from the private chat, and Ao Wu originally wanted to calm down and do his homework again.
But with the huge sum of 5,000 incense in hand, plus the one or two small errands he had done and the incense he had accumulated before, he already had 5,500 incense.
